name: strictlybetter
description: A universal research loop for Codex. Every merge is strictly better: improved on a goal beyond measured noise, worse on nothing, confirmed on a holdout the experimenter never saw.

plugins.name: strictlybetter
plugins.description: Universal noise-aware research loop: orient, discover metrics, measure sigma, pre-register experiments, blind-judge, confirm on holdout, keep only strictly-better changes. Shares the same skills/ and scripts/ as the Claude Code plugin.
